title: Listen to the soil, not the calendar.
body: Check moisture below the surface before watering. Light, temperature, pot size, and season change how quickly soil dries.

title: A little turn goes a long way.
body: Rotate your plant a quarter turn each week so every side has a chance to reach the light.

title: Make leaf checks a quiet ritual.
body: Look under leaves and along stems once a week. Catching a pest early makes care much easier.

title: Give roots room to breathe.
body: Use pots with drainage holes and empty saucers after watering. A layer of stones cannot replace drainage.
